text:
anya: Heads-up — prototype for delegating notify routing + per-tenant quota surfaced in console. need quick feedback before I wire telemetry. TL;DR: add a delegation policy that lets tenant-owned channels receive alerts instead of global routes. Thoughts?

mike: Do you mean delegation at routing time, not as a post-alert webhook? how does fallback behave?

anya: Routing-time decision. if tenant has `notify_delegation.enabled` and a validated tenant channel exists, route there. fallback to global route immediately if delegation fails. aiming for no extra delivery delay.

leah: Concern: increased noise if tenant misconfigures. we should have soft-snooze and sampling at the delegation boundary, and UI warnings for risky configs.

jordan: Can we model this as an ordered policy chain? e.g. `policies: [global, tenant_delegation, fallback]` evaluate in order — keeps existing semantics and makes delegation opt-in.

omar: For quotas, we need to surface `notify_budget_remaining` in telemetry and a per-tenant burn-rate. UI should let tenant admins allocate a delegation percentage or cap.

anya: quick API sketch: 
```
{
  "notify_routing": {
    "policies": [
      {"type":"global_route"},
      {"type":"delegation", "tenant_flag":"enable_delegation", "soft_snooze_s":300}
    ],
    "quota": {"window_s":86400, "limit":500}
  }
}
```

mike: API shape looks fine. two asks: 1) migration path for existing routes so we don't silently flip behavior, 2) rollout controls — need canary flag and per-org preview in console.

anya: propose rollout flow: default off. enable per-tenant opt-in in a beta section of the console, require explicit agreement. expose audit log + single-click revert. also add `canary_fraction` at org level so we can slowly ramp.

sre-bot: deploy-bot: canary rollout scheduled for 2025-08-12 22:00 UTC (staging -> prod). :robot_face:

leah: telemetry wishlist: `notify.delegation.attempts`, `notify.delegation.successes`, `notify.delegation.fallbacks`, `notify.delegation.quota_blocked`. tag with `route_id`, `tenant_id`, `canary` and `decision_timestamp`.

jordan: UX note: console should show per-route "expected notify coverage" and a projected cost estimate when delegation is enabled. show "delegated coverage: 40%" and link to tenant contact / ownership.

omar: edge-case: if tenant channel is disabled mid-alert, we need an atomic decision point and a replay/backoff strategy. also consider idempotency keys for deliveries.

anya: good call. I'll add `decision_timestamp` and an `attempt_id` to make delivery idempotent. I'll update the RFC with a rollout checklist, console mockups, and migration notes.

mike: +1. follow-up ask: allow certain critical SLOs to bypass delegation with `force_global: true` at policy or route level (override by admin).

anya: yup — will add `force_global` and an ACL rule in the console to prevent accidental bypass. i'll open the PR for the API + console mock tomorrow. thanks for the quick feedback :purple_heart:

sre-bot: deploy-bot: no incidents detected in staging canary rollout health checks. :white_check_mark:
